meta: Pharmacies use AI to spot stock that's running low or about to expire, and to make large-print instructions for older customers.

muc.title: Instructions that are hard to read
muc.text: Older customers often forget how to take their medicine. Pharmacies can ask AI to lay out large-print instruction sheets.

muc.title: Low stock and near expiry
muc.text: Paste your item list with quantities and expiry dates, and ask AI to flag what's running low or about to expire.

muc.title: Large-print sheets
muc.text: Ask AI to format the instructions in large print, split into morning, noon and evening, but the pharmacist writes and checks the content.

muc.title: AI doesn't prescribe
muc.text: Don't use AI to prescribe or diagnose. That's the pharmacist's and doctor's job. And remove customer names when pasting.

muc.title: What to reorder first
muc.text: Paste a few items with quantities and expiry dates, and ask a chatbot which ones to reorder first.
